chronology: Designed after the external TOW comparison was completed and its aggregate cell residuals were inspected, but before those residuals were propagated through the co2gap fuel and decomposition model.
scope: Laboratory-only paired structural sensitivity. No change to the September release, public site, production data or January work.
question: How much does the co2gap total, lateral and vertical gap change when the measured PRC-minus-co2gap initial-mass pattern is transferred as one combined carried-mass perturbation by aircraft type and flown-distance cell?

cell_definition.intervals: left-closed and right-open, matching the external TOW validation
cell_definition.lookup: Exact aircraft_type and distance_band_km match against the 77 retained aggregate cells in tow-validation-result.json.
cell_definition.unsupported_cell_policy: Apply zero perturbation, retain the flight in every paired scenario and report sample plus expanded-weight support. Do not extrapolate by type, family or distance.

mass_perturbation.name: PRC 2022 selected-airline cell-mean alignment pattern
mass_perturbation.requested_fraction_mtow: scale times (PRC mean minus co2gap mean), equal to -scale times co2gap_minus_prc_pp_mtow divided by 100
mass_perturbation.implementation: Add requested_fraction_mtow times OpenAP MTOW to the combined non-trip initial-mass term before iterating trip fuel. Apply the same cell perturbation to observed, ideal and hybrid trajectories.
mass_perturbation.reason_for_combined_term: One TOW value cannot identify payload, carried reserve and trip fuel separately. The scenario must not disguise the residual as a corrected load factor or reserve distribution.
mass_perturbation.trip_fuel: Recompute iteratively for every trajectory after applying the combined carried-mass perturbation.
mass_perturbation.mtow_policy: Preserve the model's existing MTOW cap and report realised initial-mass shifts plus cap counts; do not claim the requested shift is always realised exactly.
mass_perturbation.oew_policy: A perturbation that makes the combined non-trip term fall below OEW is a scenario failure. With full paired precision enabled, any flight failure makes the run terminate non-zero.
mass_perturbation.ground_policy: Keep the stored nominal ground-fuel share fixed, as in the existing paired sensitivity harness; record this as a limitation rather than silently claiming ground mass was recomputed.

scenarios.purpose: Corrected-wind experimental nominal with the release mass assumptions unchanged.
Transfer the full observed PRC-minus-co2gap type/distance cell-mean pattern as a structural scenario, not a correction or probability bound.

sampling.design: Use the three existing balanced stratified samples without redrawing or changing their allocation.
sampling.precision: Use the existing paired finite-population Taylor linearisation. It estimates conditional sampling precision only, not physical or transfer uncertainty.
sampling.complete_pairing: All flights and both scenarios must succeed; no limit, imputation, scenario-specific deletion or unverified input is permitted.

estimands.primary: prc_cell_mean_alignment minus nominal in gap_total_pct, in percentage points, on the primary seed
secondary: paired changes in gap_lateral_pct and gap_vertical_pct
paired changes in calibrated and uncalibrated CO2 totals
conditional sampling standard errors for the three gap contrasts
requested and realised MTOW-fraction shifts, MTOW-cap frequency and supported-cell coverage
same metrics on the two unchanged robustness samples
estimands.sign: Positive means transferring the PRC cell pattern increases the co2gap inefficiency gap relative to the corrected-wind nominal.

stopping_rule: Report the primary and both robustness runs as observed. Do not retune cells, add smoothing, change scale, redraw samples or create a probability range after seeing the CO2 effects.

permitted: A paired structural sensitivity to an externally measured type/distance mass pattern.
A check of whether mass-pattern effects cancel in the gap even when absolute fuel changes.
A basis for deciding whether a richer mass model deserves future development.
forbidden: Calling the PRC pattern representative of all 2026 ECAC flights.
Calling the scenario a correction, bound, confidence interval or probability distribution.
Inferring separate payload, load-factor, reserve-fuel or trip-fuel distributions.
Changing the September release, its site or its headline.
Treating this as preparation of the January release.

known_limitations: PRC covers selected participating airlines in 2022, while co2gap covers January-July 2026.
Aircraft type and distance do not control airline, cabin, exact variant, route, season or operating policy.
Distances come from different trajectory-processing chains.
Unsupported release cells receive zero perturbation and therefore remain explicitly unvalidated by this scenario.
The model retains nominal ground-fuel shares under the mass perturbation.
The existing corrected-wind nominal is experimental and is not the frozen public release.

output_policy.private_sampling_moments: Write only outside the repository with restrictive permissions.
